subject.title: fix(scripts): warn when postinstall detects running gateway with stale module imports

question: After the config-resolution defect is fixed, should OpenClaw accept a postinstall loopback probe plus OPENCLAW_DISABLE_POSTINSTALL_RESTART_WARNING as an advisory stale-gateway mitigation?
rationale: The code defect is mechanically repairable, but install-time network probing, a new environment surface, and overlap with the update-CLI warning PR are maintainer product and operator-experience choices.

options.title: Fix Then Accept Advisory
options.body: Repair config resolution first, then allow this postinstall warning as a partial mitigation that does not close the stale-gateway issue.

options.title: Require Packaged Gateway Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted proof from a real package update or rollback with a running gateway before deciding on the postinstall probe.

options.title: Pause For One Recovery Layer
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers want stale-gateway recovery handled only in update CLI output or runtime stale-import handling.

recommendation.title: Fix Then Accept Advisory
recommendation.body: Repair config resolution first, then allow this postinstall warning as a partial mitigation that does not close the stale-gateway issue.
